limitations: The only new model input is pin rate 18.00 to 17.10 Gb/s; this is not full GDDR6 protocol, AC-timing, address-map or controller calibration.
D1/D2 hardware values are differences between independent cold-prefix captures, not direct same-run phase counters. Their observed intervals are not confidence intervals.
Model duration uses core cycles at fixed2175MHz. Hardware duration is profiled ROI time; neither is unprofiled natural inference latency.
R4 CLOCK/hash2/carveout/dirty-age/lazy-sector cache policies remain unported; existing cache, epoch, capacity and physical routing assumptions are unchanged.
Physical writes belong to triggering operations; passive first/last dirty-writer margins are a distinct axis, not byte ownership.
Full traffic agreement cannot establish Decode writeback agreement. Report all three phases, including tiny writes.

Owned wall time includes runner validation. Native preparation/execution/finalization are separate. Source preflight is a limited measured preparation item; complete external preparation is unknown. No historical preparation or build cost is silently reused; host speed comparisons are not made.

host_budget_override.reason: Only extend host execution tolerance after the prior deadline failure; retain the 3600s performance target, all model inputs and cleanup validators.
